description:
Owner decision 2026-10-28: users must see which SQL translator produced each run in the Explorer. The read model has no translator column (_project/design/browser-duckdb-schema.sql ~:38-119; version 17 in the explorer pipeline contract.py ~:4). Add per-run `translator_version`, `translator_fork_sha` and `translator_version_source` (recorded | attested | not_recorded | not_applicable for execution_mode dataframe), populated by the shared resolver from bundle-translator-version-sidecar-attestation.

BUMP PROCEDURE (ADR site-repo-split D16; adr-site-docs-ownership 'Bundle compatibility and activation'): core first gains the capability without changing what it publishes; the site then accepts both versions; only then core switches its default output (separate item explorer-read-model-18-activate). So this item builds read model 18 ONLY behind an explicit selector; default output and site_inputs.py stay at 17.

GUARDRAILS: additive columns only; no ranking or identity change; snapshot/fixture regeneration through the pipeline's own commands; per-query hashes out of scope; do not change published Explorer output.
